Module io.github.brantunger.unruly
Package io.github.brantunger.unruly.mvel

Class MvelExpressionLanguage

java.lang.Object
io.github.brantunger.unruly.mvel.MvelExpressionLanguage
All Implemented Interfaces:
ExpressionLanguage
public final class MvelExpressionLanguage extends Object implements ExpressionLanguage
MVEL 2 as an expression language for the engine, named "mvel". A rule whose language is null is written in MVEL when MVEL is the engine's only language, or when RulesEngineBuilder.defaultLanguage(String) names it.
  • Conditions and actions have the same access to the JVM as Java code, including processes, files and reflection. There is no sandbox, so only use rules from trusted sources.
  • A condition is rejected when its text contains an assignment, ++, --, or the keywords with, def, function or import_static. A write made by calling a method, such as claim.setApproved(true), can't be detected.
  • Variables an action declares stay local to that action, and assigning to output fails.
  • A fact name must be a Java identifier that isn't one of MVEL's reserved words, such as empty or in, and isn't a class name MVEL resolves instead, such as Math or an imported class.
  • MVEL caches accessors in a compiled expression without synchronization, so each session, which one run uses at a time, runs its own compiled copy of each expression.
